profile.summary:

honors.title: Phi Beta Kappa Inductee
honors.description:
Phi Beta Kappa is the oldest and one of the most prestigious academic honor societies in the United States, founded in 1776. It recognizes exceptional achievement in the liberal arts and sciences, emphasizing intellectual integrity, academic excellence, and a commitment to the values of learning and inquiry.

Membership is highly distinguished because it is offered to only the top 10% of arts and sciences graduates from select institutions, often based on rigorous academic standards, breadth of study, and faculty recommendations. Being elected to Phi Beta Kappa is considered a mark of outstanding scholarly achievement and intellectual promise.

honors.title: Customer First Award - NCR Voyix Summer 2024 Internship
honors.description: Awarded to projects that demonstrate an exemplary commitment to delivering innovative and high-quality solutions that prioritize customer needs and satisfaction.

projects.title: Distributed Map Reduce
projects.description: A small, fault-tolerant MapReduce framework in Go, based on Google's MapReduce paper and built as part of MIT's 6.5840 Distributed Systems.

projects.title: PandOS - Operating System in C
projects.description: Developed a didactic operating system using C for the MIPS architecture on the μMPS3 emulator, implementing key functionalities such as process management, process scheduling, system calls, interrupt handling, and virtual memory management.

organizations.name: Phi Beta Kappa Honor Society
organizations.description:
Phi Beta Kappa is the oldest and most prestigious academic honor society in the United States, founded in 1776. It recognizes outstanding academic achievement in the liberal arts and sciences, emphasizing intellectual integrity, academic excellence, and a broad-based education.

Membership is highly selective and typically limited to the top 10% of graduating seniors at colleges with Phi Beta Kappa chapters. Candidates must have demonstrated excellence across a wide range of disciplines, including mathematics, humanities, natural sciences, and social sciences, and have studied a foreign language and quantitative reasoning.

Being elected to Phi Beta Kappa is considered one of the highest academic honors a student can receive in the U.S. liberal arts tradition.

organizations.name: Pi Mu Epsilon Honor Society
organizations.description:
Pi Mu Epsilon is a national mathematics honor society dedicated to promoting scholarly activity in mathematics among students, faculty, and the broader mathematical community. Founded in 1914, its primary goal is to recognize and encourage excellence in mathematical scholarship at both the undergraduate and graduate levels.

Membership is by invitation and typically extended to students who have demonstrated strong academic performance in mathematics courses and overall academic excellence.
